errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect as it fails to recognize that the 'Ours' bar is visually emphasized through a distinct color (orange) compared to the other three bars which are all blue.
The visible range of the y-axis starts with the tick mark for 0.1, not 0.0. Stating the range starts at 0.0 is an assumption not directly supported by the axis labels.
The 'Ours' bar extends to the midpoint between 0.3 and 0.4, making its value approximately 0.35, not 0.34.
